text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Opsumit (macitentan) include stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, headache, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, headache, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections

list.snippet: Nasal and throat irritation: Stuffy nose, runny nose, or sore throat.
Headache: Mild to moderate head pain.
Respiratory issues: Bronchitis or airway irritation.
Infections: Urinary tract infections and flu-like symptoms.
Anemia: Low red blood cell counts, which can cause unusual tiredness or pale skin.
Fluid retention and swelling: Swelling in the hands, legs, or ankles, or rapid weight gain, often occurring in the first few weeks.
Liver damage: Elevated liver enzymes or potential liver injury. Signs include nausea, vomiting, upper right stomach pain, fatigue, yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice), and dark urine.
Severe birth defects: Opsumit is strictly contraindicated during pregnancy and causes severe harm to an unborn baby.
Decreased sperm count: Reduced male fertility and lower sperm counts.

text_blocks.snippet: You can review full prescribing safety guidelines through the Official Opsumit Site or the National Institutes of Health DailyMed.
